{"script":"cat > count_files.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

dir="test_directory"
if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
  echo "0"
  exit 0
fi

total=0
shopt -s nullglob
for d in "$dir"/*/; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  count=$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)
  total=$((total + count))
done

echo "$total"
EOF

chmod +x count_files.sh
./count_files.sh
"}
